title: when building a UI brief, check that every path the brief tells the role to write is inside the temp directory, the renders directory or the report path

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The ui reported this as tool feedback (deterministic-check) on ork in ork run ork-20261119-234354-c0f6, project ork, item S475:

when building a UI brief, check that every path the brief tells the role to write is inside the temp directory, the renders directory or the report path

Evidence: brief.go:173 sends -renders to TempDir, which is outside the writable set that brief.go:171 and brief.go:188 give the role.
